## TRA Timeline

#### Origination at JV formation

- 2017-03-01: McKesson TRA executed at JV closing between Change Healthcare LLC (the JV), PF2 IP LLC, PF2 PST Services Inc., McKesson Corporation, and HCIT Holdings (Echo)
- 2019-03-15: Filed under Change Healthcare Inc.'s CIK as Exhibit 10.2 to S-1

#### Termination at UnitedHealth merger

- 2022-10-03: UnitedHealth merger Effective Time; Company gave contractual notice of intention to terminate the McKesson TRA (along with the Management TRA) on the terms set forth in the agreement, with termination effective at a future date following the Effective Time

## Explanation

This TRA originated at the March 1, 2017 close of the McKesson / Change Healthcare joint venture, with McKesson as the sole beneficiary. The covered tax assets are basis step-ups on assets McKesson contributed to the JV at formation plus imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments; the rate is the standard 85%. Unlike the Sponsor-side TRAs covered by the January 5, 2021 Acknowledgment, the McKesson TRA was terminated only at the Effective Time of the UnitedHealth merger by contractual notice the Company delivered October 3, 2022 (alongside the Management TRA). See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
